intent: A receiver that reads nothing of a camera for the first 2.5 s, then the backlog at once. The media start moves back at most 1 s from the first frame's arrival. So the start is 1.5 s, late by the stall less 1 s, and frame 0 plays 1 s before its read. RED: without that limit the start moves back to 501 ms; with a 500 ms limit it is 2000 ms; a start that never moves back stays at 2500 ms.
residuals: mediaStartUs: ideal 333 (the frames from 75 on are on time; with ms PTS the least delayed, frame 76, is 333 us late), pinned 1500000: the start moves back at most MediaSpanMaxBacklog (1 s) from the first frame's arrival, as bbb-webrtc-sfu ignores a start more than 1 s before its request
